title: Customer panel
nav.label: Panel menu
login.title: Open your bookings
login.description: Enter the phone number you booked with and we will send you a sign-in code.
login.footer: Codes go only to numbers a business has on record. You see the bookings of every business in one place.
login.code_description: If the number is on record, we sent a 6 digit code to {{phone}}.
login.invalid_code: The code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
reservations.title: My bookings
reservations.description: Every booking made with your phone number, whichever business it is with.
reservations.empty_upcoming_description: A new booking shows up here.
reservations.empty_past_description: Completed and cancelled bookings are listed here.
detail.title: Booking
detail.not_found: The booking was not found or is not yours.
detail.awaiting: Your request is waiting for the business to approve it.
detail.awaiting_until: Your request is waiting for the business to approve it. Without an answer by {{at}} it is cancelled on its own.
detail.reschedule_until: You can change the time until {{at}}.
policies.title: Business rules
cancel.title: Cancel the booking?
cancel.description: Your booking is cancelled and its time is freed for others. This cannot be undone.
reschedule.description: Pick a new free time for the same services. Your old time is let go only once the new one is taken.
reschedule.closed: The business is closed that day
reschedule.too_far: That day is not open for booking yet
reschedule.too_soon: It is too late for that day
reasons.status: The booking cannot be changed in its current state.
reasons.cutoff: The time the business allows has passed; call the business to change it.
reasons.business_unavailable: The business does not take online changes right now.
reasons.online_unavailable: The business does not take online bookings right now; call it to change the time.
reasons.services_changed: A service of this booking is no longer offered; call the business to change it.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a little.
errors.taken: The time you picked was just taken. Pick another time.
errors.stale: The booking changed while you were looking; the page was refreshed, try again.
errors.invalid_transition: This is not possible in the booking's current state.
payments.title: My payments
payments.description: What your bookings cost, what you paid and what you got back.
payments.note: Amounts come from the business's payment records. A payment you made at the business shows here once the business records it.
payments.empty_description: The amounts of your bookings are listed here.
profile.title: My profile
profile.description: Your verified number, the businesses that know you and your sessions.
profile.no_businesses_description: A business shows up here once you book with this number.
profile.logout_everywhere_description: Every open panel session of this number ends; each device needs a new code to sign in.
reasons.sign_in_required: Sign in to the panel to change the time.
link.title: Open your bookings
link.description: This link was sent to you by SMS. Continue to see all your bookings.
link.footer: The link works once and for 24 hours. Do not share it.
link.invalid_description: This link has expired or was already used. You can sign in with a code sent to your phone.
visit.invalid_title: The booking link is not valid
visit.invalid_description: This link has expired or was revoked. Sign in with your phone to see your bookings.
visit.only_this: This link opens only this booking. Sign in with your phone for your other bookings.
devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Devices signed in to your panel. Sign out any device you do not recognise at once.
devices.revoke_description: The device leaves the panel at once; signing in again needs a code.
profile.change_phone_hint: If your number changed, confirm the new one. Your bookings move with your profile; the next holder of the old number cannot see them.
profile.reassigned_hint: If this number was recently given to you and you see bookings you do not know, hide the previous holder's history.
profile.history_notice_reassigned: Takwim was told that this number was given to someone else. Bookings made before {{at}} may belong to the previous holder and are not shown; bookings you make from now on appear here.
profile.history_notice_dormant: This number was not confirmed for a long time and may have been given to someone else. Bookings made before {{at}} are not shown; bookings you make from now on appear here. Your earlier bookings stay on record at the businesses.
phone_change.title: Change my number
phone_change.description: Enter your new number; the confirmation code goes to that number.
phone_change.code_description: Enter the 6 digit code sent to {{phone}}.
phone_change.done: Your number was changed. Sessions on other devices were ended.
phone_change.same: This is already your profile's number.
phone_change.in_use: This number has its own Takwim profile. Profiles are not merged; you can sign in with that number separately.
reassigned.title: This number was recently given to me
reassigned.description: At the businesses you do not tick, earlier bookings and the name on record are hidden; bookings made from now on show. Sessions on other devices end. Nothing is deleted at the businesses.
reassigned.keep_hint: Tick the businesses whose bookings are yours.
reassigned.done: The previous holder's history is hidden.
refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.hint: Refunds in progress reach your account within a few business days, depending on your bank. Contact the business with any question.
ledger.title: Payment history
ledger.hint: Payments and refunds the business recorded, including payments made in parts.
products.title: Products
products.hint: The products you take with this visit are set aside for you; their amounts are in the visit total.
products.released_hint: The visit did not take place, so the products were released; they are not part of the amount due.
reasons.not_requested: The business does not ask to confirm this booking.
reasons.answered: You already answered this confirmation request.
confirmation.title: Confirm your booking
confirmation.ask: The business asks you to confirm that you are coming.
confirmation.ask_until: The business asks you to confirm that you are coming. Please answer by {{at}}.
confirmation.cancel_hint: If you cannot come, cancel the booking so the time opens up for others.
confirmation.confirmed: You confirmed your booking. See you there!
confirmation.change_sent: Your change request was sent to the business.
confirmation.change_sent_hint: Your booking stands until the business gets back to you. You can still confirm it if the time works.
confirmation.change_description: Tell the business you would like another time. Your booking stays until the business changes it.
confirmation.note_hint: Optional; for example the days and times that suit you.
confirmation.note_too_long: The note can be at most 500 characters.
confirmation.done: Thank you, your booking is confirmed.
packages.title: My packages
packages.description: Session packages you bought from businesses: sessions left, last day and usage history.
packages.note: The business keeps the session count and the last day. When you book online while signed in you can pick your package.
packages.empty_description: A session package you buy from a business shows up here.
packages.refunded_note: This package was refunded on {{date}}; its sessions can no longer be used.
packages.held_hint: Sessions set aside for visits that have not happened yet
packages.history_hint: Visits that used a session. A cancelled visit gives its session back and is not listed.
packages.history_empty: No session of this package has been used yet
